hints.title: Frequency Counting Across Lists
hints.text: An element belongs to the common subsequence if and only if it appears in every single input array.

hints.title: Counting Total Appearances
hints.text: Count how many distinct arrays contain each integer value.

hints.title: Preserving Sorted Ordering
hints.text: Since each individual array is strictly increasing, filtering elements appearing in all arrays in natural ascending order yields the answer.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: Total Elements: sum of lengths of all arrays
complexity.notes: Frequency aggregation across strictly increasing integer sequences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Classic 2D DP LCS takes exponential time across more than two sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since each sequence is strictly increasing, elements are unique within each array, simplifying to frequency counting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should realize that LCS among sorted arrays reduces to intersecting all arrays.
